nodes.description: External ILimaTokenHelper/limaTokenStorage contract reference used for all token, fee, governance and swap configuration.
Mapping tracking last deposit block per address, written with tx.origin as key.
Initializer that sets limaTokenHelper, initializes ERC20/Pausable/ReentrancyGuard and optionally pulls underlying tokens and mints.
Internal check that a token is an approved underlying token via limaTokenHelper.isUnderlyingTokens.
Internal check that a token is an approved investment token via limaTokenHelper.isInvestmentToken.
Authorization check requiring msg.sender to be limaGovernance or owner.
Conditional user check requiring msg.sender be an Amun user when the flag is active.
Returns current underlying token balance of this contract.
Pro-rata underlying balance calculation using totalSupply.
Privileged mint of new tokens, restricted to limaGovernance or owner.
Privileged pause of token transfers.
Privileged unpause of token transfers.
Sets ERC20 allowance for the limaSwap contract when needed.
Internal swap helper calling limaTokenHelper.limaSwap().swap with external untrusted swap contract.
Internal unwrap helper calling limaTokenHelper.limaSwap().unwrap on interest-bearing tokens.
Governance/owner-only public swap entry point delegating to _swap.
Governance/owner-only rebalance routine using block.timestamp interval check, unwrap fees and swaps.
Governance/owner-only forced redeem delegating to internal _redeem.
User-facing entry point pulling investment tokens, taking fees, swapping and minting Lima tokens.
Internal redeem that burns shares, takes burn fee, swaps underlying and transfers payout.
Public redeem entry point delegating to internal _redeem for msg.sender.
External caller address used for authorization, token sourcing and minting.
block.timestamp (now) used for rebalance interval logic.
Transaction origin used as key when writing userLastDeposit.
External ERC20 safeTransferFrom pulling tokens from user into the contract.
External call to the untrusted limaSwap.swap, returns variable amount and can re-enter.
External call to the untrusted limaSwap.unwrap, can re-enter the contract.
External ERC20 safeTransfer sending payout or fees to a recipient address.
External call writing lastRebalance on the helper using block.timestamp.
Internal token mint changing totalSupply and balances.
Internal token burn changing totalSupply and balances.
User-supplied amount of tokens to invest or redeem.
Address receiving redeemed payout tokens.
Token address in which redemption is paid out.
Token address used by the user to invest / create Lima tokens.
Local intermediate value of underlying tokens computed during redeem.
Local computed fee amount (mint or burn fee).
Referral identifier emitted on create.
Local snapshot of underlying token balance at start of create.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against limaGovernance/owner to authorize sensitive functions.
msg.sender is checked against the Amun user list when the flag is active.
msg.sender is the source of safeTransferFrom and the minted recipient in create.
msg.sender is used for the last-deposit guard inside _redeem.
tx.origin is used as the key when writing userLastDeposit, bypassing msg.sender identity.
tx.origin is written into userLastDeposit inside _redeem, not the actual caller.
block.timestamp (now) determines whether rebalance can run, a timestamp-dependency.
Investment token parameter flows into swap and fee transfers.
Amount parameter flows into fee computation, swap and mint.
Recipient parameter is the destination of the payout safeTransfer.
Payout token parameter flows into swap and payout transfer.
_swap performs an external call into the untrusted limaSwap.swap contract.
_unwrap performs an external call into the untrusted limaSwap.unwrap contract.
initialize pulls underlying tokens via safeTransferFrom.
initialize mints initial Lima tokens to msg.sender.
create pulls the investment amount from the sender.
create calls the internal swap helper before minting, exposing an external call path.
create mints Lima tokens to the recipient after swapping.
_redeem burns the investor shares before external calls.
_redeem unwraps the burn fee through an external call.
_redeem swaps underlying for payout token via external call.
_redeem transfers payout to the recipient via external ERC20 transfer.
rebalance unwraps the performance fee to the fee wallet via external call.
rebalance swaps governance and underlying tokens via external calls.
rebalance writes lastRebalance on the helper using the current timestamp.
forceRedeem delegates to the internal _redeem routine.
redeem delegates to the internal _redeem routine for msg.sender.
public swap delegates to the internal _swap helper.
_swap approves the limaSwap contract before swapping.
_unwrap approves the limaSwap contract before unwrapping.
privileged mint function invokes token minting.
create modifier validates the investment/underlying token via helper.
create modifier enforces the Amun user restriction.
_redeem modifier validates the payout token is an allowed investment token.
underlying token validation reads configuration from limaTokenHelper.
investment token validation reads configuration from limaTokenHelper.
authorization reads limaGovernance and owner from limaTokenHelper.
Amun user check reads the activation flag from limaTokenHelper.
create reads fees, current underlying token and swap settings from limaTokenHelper.
_redeem reads fees, fee wallet and swap settings from limaTokenHelper.
rebalance reads and writes configuration on limaTokenHelper.
malicious swap contract can re-enter create while its state is mid-update.
malicious swap contract can re-enter _redeem before payout completes.
malicious unwrap contract can re-enter _redeem during fee unwrap.
payout token transfer can re-enter create (token hook).
payout token transfer can re-enter _redeem (token hook).
investment token transferFrom can re-enter create before balance accounting completes.

normalization_plan.reason: User-supplied amount is only meaningful as input to the create flow; fold into create.
Recipient bounds the payout transfer inside _redeem; fold into the redeem routine.
Payout token parameter determines the swap/transfer target inside _redeem.
Investment token parameter drives fee transfer and swap inside create.
Transient computed underlying amount used only inside _redeem.
Transient burn fee value scoped to _redeem.
Referral id is only emitted by create; fold into create.
Transient balance snapshot used for mint math inside create.
